freeze_gate: matched arms and exact source commits
independent actual reviewer IDs and roles
protocol hash published before output access

baseline.role: pre-enhancement runtime; verify capability before capture

treatment.role: integrated editorial enhancements; freeze final tool/source commit separately

candidate_arms.unsupported_policy: Record not_supported without replacing outputs; after-only never establishes improvement.

repeats.rationale: First bounded descriptive pilot across all nine cases; two independent human perspectives per paired output. One run does not estimate model stochastic variance or support statistical/population claims. Increase repetitions only in a new preregistered version, never replace an unfavorable first run.
repeats.failure_policy: Keep first result/failure/unsupported cell; any retry is separately counted and reported, not a replacement.

cases.reason: Included to observe exploratory adoption and decision provenance/restart limits
Included to observe exploratory adoption and decision provenance/restart limits

preservation_conflict_overlay.material_policy: Use unchanged current source/brief. Observe prohibition versus preference and attainable limits; no new source bytes or case IDs.

reviewers.role_policy: Same person with two IDs or two roles does not meet independence. Real self-attribution is evidence, not authentication. Constructed intent is disclosed; intent reviewer evaluates the supplied brief rather than claiming to be its original author.
reviewers.blinding: Independent quality scoring reads only canonical anonymous review packet; mapping, provider/model and cost metadata withheld until quality records are frozen. Record seed and mapping separately.

scoring.approval_burden: Null unless author-visible interaction evidence supports judging avoidability; required approvals are safeguards.
scoring.serious_errors: Record source, side, description, impact, disposition and reason separately; never average away a serious error or protection breach.
scoring.uncertainty: Retain explicit unobserved reason and case-level uncertainty in participant evidence.

decision_rules.case_improved: Matched actual outputs and complete source-bound workflow observations; two distinct independent author-intent and reader/editor reviews with all five dimensions observed; no unresolved important error/protection breach or failed authority observation. Both reviewers score treatment intent higher, voice/error/restraint/approval burden no lower. Otherwise retain each dimension and classify honestly.
decision_rules.case_regression: Any unresolved important error, protection breach or failed authority safeguard, or both reviewers score treatment lower on intent/voice/error/restraint. Disagreement remains visible.
decision_rules.case_no_improvement: Eligible complete reviews show equal dimension vectors and neither prefers treatment; no serious error/protection breach.
decision_rules.case_mixed: Complete eligible evidence has opposing reviewer judgments or gains on one dimension with losses on another, without a rule requiring regression.
decision_rules.case_insufficient: Missing/mismatched outputs/settings, unsupported baseline, missing distinct independent author-intent and reader/editor people/rationales, unobserved any of five required dimensions (including approval burden without interaction context), or missing required workflow observations. Keep partial results but no complete effect/improvement claim.
decision_rules.overall: No scalar aggregate. Report every case state and five-axis paired differences, disagreement, errors, protection and costs. Limited pilot can report observed improvement only if all nine included cases meet case_improved; any regression is surfaced; heterogeneous complete cases are mixed; missing included cases retain insufficient_data. Not a general literary-quality claim.
decision_rules.completion: Actual negative results can complete evaluation; absent real outputs or independent human records cannot close issue806 or parent791.

retain: all submitted calls including retries/failures/context work

change_policy: After output access any rule/case/repeat/arm/reviewer change starts a new protocol_id/version/hash; retain earlier outcomes and reason.
